climate: Most rain falls in winter. Dry summers keep mildew and rot down, though young vines may need watering.

blurb.text: A DOC in the Algarve centered on the Lagoa municipality, historically known for fortified wine and now making more table wine. Allowed grapes include Touriga Nacional, Castelão, Negra Mole, Syrah, Arinto and Síria.
